description: Remove a dependency between tasks. Requires task + exactly one of: depends_on or dependency_of matching the existing dependency. Supports name or ID for all tasks.

dependency_of.description: Task name or ID of the dependency to remove (the task that was blocked by 'task'). Provide this OR depends_on.

dependency_of_list.description: List name for resolving dependency_of task by name.

depends_on.description: Task name or ID of the dependency to remove (the task that 'task' was blocked by). Provide this OR dependency_of.

depends_on_list.description: List name for resolving depends_on task by name.

listName.description: List name for resolving task by name.

task.description: Task name or ID to remove the dependency from. REQUIRED.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: delete_task_dependency
